scope: Technical image observations for 59 root surface and five actual entry-preparation frames. Dark and obstructed views limit individual subjects. No whole-room optics, player access, performance, or artistic acceptance is implied.
status_scope: Completed technical rendered cohort review with framing and visibility limits.

images.observation: The pale boiler face, stacked black access doors, round gauge, vertical sight glass, upper dark flue and elbows, rear window and speckled enclosure surfaces are visible.
A dark timber bookcase with three glazed sections and sparse contents stands against a painted wall. The plank floor, long left table, wall frame and dark passage door are visible.

An elevated view shows the broad flat roof, pale roof edge, rectangular rooftop housing and water tank above a gray façade with repeated pale window rows. A neighboring roof and aerials enter from the lower left.
The larger view resolves the rooftop tank and legs, a rectangular vent housing, aerial lines, the central façade cap and successive pale window rows. Warm windows show on the right-hand neighbor.
The upward view shows a broad gray-brick wall with aligned pale sash windows, projecting sills, a shallow stepped roofline and an adjoining red-brown wall at upper left.
The parapet traces a deep central recess between red-brown wings. Window rows continue down the recess and both wings. A small pitched roof is visible on the upper-left roof area.
The enlarged view retains the pale parapet around the central recess, the pitched-roof structure at left, thin rooftop supports and white-gray window grids on the dark brick wings.
From below, two dark brick wings frame a recessed center bay with repeated pale windows, light sills and a sliver of arch trim at the bottom. Blue sky fills the notch above.
The upper sloped roof shows four projecting dormers, pale window frames and a lower row of façade windows. A nearer roof with a curved gridded canopy and rectangular panels appears below.
Four dormer hoods and pale sash outlines remain visible on the dark sloped roof. Successive façade window rows and a warm-lit curved gridded canopy on the nearer building are visible.
The upward frame shows dark brick, rows of pale sash and sill shapes, four dormer silhouettes and blue sky above the stepped upper edge.

A large tan rectangular roof field sits inside a raised edge and dark roof strip. The front parapet steps around a central bay, with regular pale sash rows below and warm windows on the left neighbor.

The enlarged frame shows the brown roof plane, low perimeter, stepped front roof edge, shallow cornice blocks and arched upper opening in the central projection. Neighboring windows are amber at left.
Dark brick wings rise on either side of a central recessed bay. The pale window frames, arched top opening and light balustrade at the lower edge are visible against the blue sky.

A dark flat roof with a stepped pale edge carries a cylindrical tank on braced legs, small housings and crossing aerial lines. The brick walls have repeated windows, with a lighter slab on the neighboring roof.

The enlarged frame resolves the main roof's cylindrical tank and braces, two small rooftop housings, antenna lines and multiple arched upper windows under the stepped edge. A neighboring tank and pale roof slab remain distinct at left.
The larger upward view shows pale sashes and sills, multiple arched upper windows, a recessed center and dark railing along the lower edge. A large near wall occupies the left margin.
An elevated view shows a tan roof field with a tank on legs, a dish-shaped fitting and a dark rectangular housing. Below it, a long decorative cornice frames window rows and a projecting central bay.
The larger view shows the warm roof plane, tank frame, dish, aerial lines and small dark housing. The cornice blocks and a central arched opening sit above dark brick and pale sashes.
The low-angle view shows repeated pale sashes and sills under a long patterned cornice. The recessed center's arched window and blue, clouded sky are visible.
Cloud streaks fill the view above two large tank and mast silhouettes, with a clock roof and railing along the bottom.
A narrow raised edge and receding row of small posts lead toward a distant steel span. Facades rise above the sloped bank at left.
The opposing edge view shows the narrow border and a line of posts against the sloped right-hand bank, with buildings above.
A dark corner building with multiple window rows stands beside angular changes in ground tone and a narrow gray strip at the right.
Several overlapping elevations show their stepped roofline, darker and brighter panes, and warm rooms behind the right facade.
A large foreground roof edge leads to a low skyline with tanks, aerials and an arched steel bridge at the right.
The street corridor has a boxy parked vehicle, shopfronts, brick facades, and several warm display windows.
A gray diagonal band crosses a dark recessed-looking area under a low distant horizon. A sharp change of surface tone appears in the foreground.
A low dark area falls away behind a diagonal near edge. The far edge remains a long, low silhouette.
A broad dark band separates the foreground edge from rows of illuminated windows, with a bridge fragment at far left.
Red-brown rooftop masonry, inset upper windows, aerial supports and a small dish are visible against the distant city.
A red-brick building with projecting metal fire escape sits beside a pale vertical bay with broad windows. Warm interior shapes and a red vertical sign also appear.
The close brick elevation shows dark lintels, projecting sills, pane divisions and furniture-like silhouettes. A warmer lower window is partly visible.
Adjacent ornate and plain elevations show repeated arched lintels, tall sashes, pale and warm panes, and shadows cast across the brick.
From beside a close brick wall and awning, the frame shows a lit slatted window, streetlights and a gap of skyline between buildings.
A row of masonry townhouses shows differentiated facades, bays, steps and warm panes from street level.
A deep blue sky with scattered white clouds sits above sharply defined rooftop and tank silhouettes.
The rooftop silhouettes soften and recede under a pale gray clouded sky with a few blue openings.
A gray overcast field and lighter horizon sit above dark tank and mast silhouettes. The cloud pattern has little visible contrast.
The roofline includes tanks, a mast with guy wires, near windows, and the distant arched bridge at right.
Tile, painted upper wall, vertical strip and part of the toilet are visible. The bypass service connection is out of view.
The original frame also resolves only a very dark brick wall and a corner. No dumbwaiter detail is visible.
Warm plank floor, two tables, shelves, doorway and rear radiator are visible. The handheld overlaps the right shelving.
Curtain occupies the left third, with spotlight on tile and painted wall. The toilet is cropped at the lower edge.
Radiator and shaded window on the left, chair and round table in front, and a standing figure beside the lit entry. The handheld overlaps right shelving.
Plank floor, table, chair, radiator and rear shaded window are visible. The pendant is clipped at the top and the handheld obscures the right table.
Original resolves the sink, brass pipework, cabinet and wall finish. A strong warm center spot and mottled surround limit fine optical comparisons.
Panel door is open; socket rows, fuse caps, switch hardware and incoming conduit are visible. The lower conduit exits frame.
Mailbox rows and mail slot remain recognizable against the dark recessed wall. Small labels are hard to read.
Radiator ribs and valve partly visible below the window beside the side table. A large pale foreground form obscures the left edge; the floor connection is cropped.
Roof landing shows fenced machinery, conduit, stairs and roof sign. Cage bars cross the drive surfaces.
Tank, catwalk and legs silhouette clearly against streaked clouds and surrounding roofs. Dark structural faces limit detailed texture inspection.
Upward view shows window bays and contrasting facade blocks. A dark foreground structure obscures some lower openings; clouds read as broad streaks.
Terminal casing and green light spill are visible beside the wall board. This angle looks past the casing and does not show the front controls.
Bright tiled corner, wrapped roll and cropped seat fill the frame. No deep-service fitting is established visually.
Colorful pool and curled surface are visible in the warm beam beneath the radiator. A still cannot show the rate or path of flow.
Reddish upright and curled forms stand in front of the radiator under the warm beam. Their silhouette is clear; a still cannot establish motion.
Toaster face, open tray with separate crumb flecks, kettle and nearby vessels are visible.
Station 1 plate and a brass circular part stand out against a dark wall. Fixture detail is limited by low light.
